note.question: What determines the creation and consumption of content on user-generated content platforms, e.g., reviews, articles, chat, videos, etc?
note.overview: This paper considers the creation and consumption of content on user-generated content platforms, e.g., reviews, articles, chat, videos, etc. On these platforms, users’ expectations regarding the amount and timing of participation by others becomes germane to their own involvement levels. Accordingly, we develop a dynamic rational expectations equilibrium model of joint consumption and generation of information.
